# Nimzo

> Nimzo turns your infrastructure policies and best practices into deterministic checks that every change passes, whoever or whatever writes it.

This file is generated from the site's source content. It is a curated index for AI assistants, not a crawler permissions file. For crawler permissions, see `/robots.txt`.

- [Home](https://www.nimzo.com/): Primary overview of the site.

## Discovery
